entries.description: Guide connector (MCP), read-only: find businesses in any country that registered themselves, check a business, find free public services and political parties in Norway, and run an AI check of a website. Never ranks; nothing can be bought.
Open index (ODbL) of businesses that registered themselves and chose the open licence on their own domain. Domain and organisation, company or VAT number checked.
Signed monthly releases of the business index (Ed25519), with the public key at /index/signing-key.json.
Open index (ODbL) of public services in Norway: state agencies by topic and the websites of all 357 municipalities. Links only.
Open index (ODbL) of political parties in Norway: links to the parties' own pages and programmes, alphabetical, never ranked. Not complete yet.
Businesses in the guide: one page per listed business in random order, each linking to the business's own website (Norwegian: /bedrifter/).
AI check: how does a website look to AI assistants? Score, points per check and concrete actions (Norwegian: /sjekk/).
Make an AI-readable business card in the browser: a schema.org snippet for the front page, plus optional llms.txt and ai-catalog.json (Norwegian: /lag/).
Register a business in the open guide. Free; placement cannot be bought (Norwegian: /meld-inn/).
Guides: AI-readable website, the snippet in WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify and Webflow, WebMCP, agent checkout and payments, MCP (Norwegian: /no/guider/).
Fictional example: an AI-readable business card for a guesthouse (Norwegian: /eksempel/gjestehus/, bakery: /eksempel/).
Overview of VegvisAI for language models.
